content.text: Keep a register of people, each with a name, an age and a gender. Gender is chosen from a fixed list of two values, MALE and FEMALE, held as one enum, so every person is described with the same vocabulary.
IN: a Person with name, age and gender; a screen to keep its rows; the Gender enum of two values (MALE, FEMALE).
OUT: date of birth or derived age, addresses, contact details, links to users or parties.
